info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 課程中將介紹專題之整理、分析以及表達方法之基礎、操作原理、研究生專題演講訓練、專題報告撰寫整理及分析。
description.describe_eh: The course contains introduction of composition, analysis and representation with special research topics and operating principles of the seminar, training of a talk representation with special topics of the graduate student, training to writing and analysis of the special topics work.

targets.describe_ch: 能用專業定理應用於碩士論文研究中，執行與驗證各項專業定理。
targets.describe_en: Can apply to study in master's thesis the theorem, carry out and verify every theorem.

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解並說明各項碩士論文研究之方法與進行程序，並適切歸納出結論。
targets.describe_en: Method that can understand and prove that the master studies thesis and carrying on the procedure, and sum up the conclusion.

targets.describe_ch: 能以書面及口頭方式將所研究結果發表。
targets.describe_en: Communicate results in written or oral form presentation.

courseBankC.core_eng: To be capable of utilizing the professional knowledge in aerospace engineering to analyze, propose and identify engineering problems, planning and carrying out case studies.

courseBankC.core_item: 具備獨立研究、解決問題、撰寫論文、持續吸收航太新知及研發創新之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: To build the ability of independent study,problem solving,thesis writing,continued learning of new information and knowledge in the area of aerospace,innovative research& development.
